name: Abron Mar's R-41 Starchaser
description: The crime lieutenant Abron Mar owned an R-41 Starchaser. He used it to fly in between Takara's stronghold and the planet Katraasii. While being chased by Mara Jade, Mar would have used his R-41 Starchaser to escape the Katraasii Spaceport, but Jade had sealed the hangar that Mar had parked his ship in. As a result, Mar decided to lay a trap for Jade instead of escape.
